case.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
case.narrative: The rear camera of my car frequently stops working, leaving me without a clear view behind. Though Polestar have attempted to improve this with OTA software updates, the problem has never truly gone away. The rear camera view is often "temporarily unavailable", it is also frequently lagging with frozen frames or video feed that misses frames.   There are many reports of this available online as other owners post to ownership forums and subreddits.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
